title: The moon could turn astronauts into 'walking, high voltage capacitors' that accidentally zap spacecraft
caption:
NASA is worried that static electricity on the moon could turn astronauts into walking hazards. They are currently looking for new ways to keep moonwalkers from zapping their own spacecraft.
